notes: The backend test_tscheck_chat posts 'tscheck-chat-*' messages to Van 2. Reset demo data cleared them at the end of the run.
The app was left at its defaults: Reset demo data was run, the team number was removed, and the API settings show wage 19.27 and no team numbers.
The East Bay speed change from 22 to 15 moved Van 2's later arrivals later (3:03pm to 3:05pm, 4:03pm to 4:04pm). Checked through the API.
Only console errors were the dev-server HMR websocket failures, plus the ERR_FAILED errors from the offline test, where API calls were blocked on purpose.

checks.evidence: Inline errors shown for blank wage and -5, nothing saved. Wage 20, clock 2:00pm and a team number showed 'Saved' and survived reload. Cost per stop rose with spare minutes unchanged. East Bay 15 lowered Van 2's spare minutes, consistent in rail, Dispatch table and header.

checks.evidence: Confirm text matches. Cancel changed nothing. 'Demo data reset' appeared and defaults were restored, team number kept, chat cleared, Van 2 back to 50 spare. Inbox and Phones placeholders correct. 6 vans after reload, no duplicate stops.
